consequence.statement: On Kafka 4.0.0 and later, the JMXReporter is not enabled unless metrics are enabled in `.spec.kafka.metrics` or JMXReporter is explicitly added to `metric.reporters`.
consequence.remediation: If you rely on the JMXReporter, enable metrics in `.spec.kafka.metrics` or add JMXReporter to `metric.reporters` in the Kafka configuration.

assertion.statement: From Kafka 4.0.0, the JMXReporter is only enabled when metrics are enabled in `.spec.kafka.metrics` or when JMXReporter is explicitly added to `metric.reporters`.
